name: Release date and platforms
subtitle: November 19, 2026 · PS5 and Xbox Series X|S
summary: Launches Thursday, November 19, 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. No PC or last-gen version has been announced.

facts.text: Rockstar set November 19, 2026 as the launch date in a November 2025 Newswire post, saying the extra months would let it finish the game with the expected level of polish.
Platforms: PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
Previously dated fall 2025, then May 26, 2026 (announced May 2, 2025), before the move to November.
As of September 2026 no Windows/PC release is scheduled; press and Take-Two have both reaffirmed there is no further delay.
Rockstar's site says the game plays best on PlayStation 5.

name: Pre-orders
subtitle: Open since June 25, 2026
summary: Pre-orders opened at midnight local time on June 25, 2026 on PlayStation Store, Microsoft Store, the Rockstar Store and retailers. Pre-loads and physical copies arrive November 12.

facts.text: Pre-orders began June 25, 2026 at midnight local time, for both editions.
Available through PlayStation Store, Microsoft Store, the Rockstar Games Store and retailers worldwide.
Digital pre-loading begins November 12, 2026; physical copies, which contain a download code, ship from the same date.
Take-Two called pre-order demand unprecedented; an analyst estimate put most pre-orders on the Ultimate Edition.

name: Standard Edition
summary: The base game, digital or physical. The physical box holds a download code rather than a disc.

facts.text: The physical version contains only a download code — no disc — reportedly to guard against leaks.

name: Ultimate Edition
subtitle: $99.99 · digital
summary: The game plus an exclusive set of vehicles, weapons, outfits, tattoos, shops and garages woven through the single-player story.

facts.text: Priced at $99.99; includes exclusive premium vehicles, weapons, apparel and items integrated throughout Jason and Lucia's campaign.

Reported contents: '95 Grotti Cheetah, '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy with Paradise Garage, Hawk & Little Morgan revolvers, personalised sidearm variants, exclusive outfits and tattoos, access to shops such as Rideout Customs, Sara's Salon, Stock 305, Electric Fang Tattoo and One-Eyed Willie's, plus the Goodtime Gear collection and a classic-car commission.
Digital only, according to press guides.

name: Vintage Vice City Pack
subtitle: Pre-order bonus
summary: A throwback bundle for anyone who pre-orders or buys before November 20: a '55 Stanier and garage, retro outfits, a tropical weapon pattern and a month of GTA+ for digital buyers.

facts.text: Included with all pre-orders and purchases made before November 20, 2026; digital pre-orders also get one free month of GTA+.
Rockstar pitches it as benefits that flash back to when the neon burned brightest.

Reported contents: '55 Vapid Stanier with the Shore Court garage near Ocean Beach (weapon locker and fencing deposit), a pastel linen suit for Jason, a red sequin dress for Lucia, and a tropical weapon pattern.
